title: Understanding Angular Momentum
text: Angular momentum $$L$$ for a rolling object is given by the formula $$L=I\omega$$, $$where$$ $$I$$ is the moment of inertia and $$\omega$$ is the angular velocity.

title: Moment of Inertia for a Sphere
text: The moment of inertia $$I$$ for a uniform solid sphere is $$I=(2/5)mr**{2}$$. $$ \cup se$$ $$this$$ $$to$$ $$calculate$$ $$I$$ $$for$$ $$the$$ $$boulder$$.

title: Relating Linear and Angular Velocity
text: The angular velocity $$\omega$$ can be found using the relation $$v=r\omega$$, $$where$$ $$v$$ is the linear velocity and $$r$$ is the radius of the sphere.

title: Finding Linear Velocity
text: Use energy conservation to find the linear velocity halfway down the hill. The potential energy at the top is converted into kinetic energy (both translational and rotational) halfway down.

title: Calculate Moment of Inertia
text: Calculate the moment of inertia $$I$$ for the boulder using $$I=(2/5)mr**{2}$$, $$where$$ $$m=20\, \text{kg}$$ and $$r=0.2\, \text{m}$$.

title: Calculate Linear Velocity
text: Use energy conservation: $$mgh=\tfrac{1}{2}mv**{2}+\tfrac{1}{2}I\omega**{2}$$. $$Solve$$ $$for$$ $$v$$ halfway down the hill.
